summary:
Chartered Accountant with 8.5 years of auditing experience, including 3.5 years of post-
qualification tenure at a Big Four firm and 5 years of pre-qualification experience(including
Articleship of 3 years). Seeking a dynamic role in a reputed organization where I can continuously
expand my expertise, contribute meaningfully to organizational success and skilled in financial
statement analysis, risk assessment, walkthrough, control testing and compliance with various
accounting standards.

bullets: Coordinate & Spearheaded 5+ audit engagements for prominent US listed clients in the Product and service sector, in Health and Education industries, achieving a 100% satisfaction rate.
Served as a main point of contact from team, achieved 100% timely delivery rate by efficient task allocation, daily check in and workflow management.
Boosted seamless collaboration by maintaining regular client and Onshore team interaction, aligning audit objectives with client priorities Engaged in regular interaction.

Actively involved in all stages of engagement, from planning to execution, review, completion and reporting. Conducted risk assessment, scoping determination and other various work papers i.e terms of Engagement, Understanding the entity and its environment, Internal controls implemented (COSO), independence procedures, Analytics and Materiality and SOC audit.
Conducted client walkthroughs, identifying key risks and ensuring thorough audit coverage and testing controls. Financial Analysis and Substantive Testing:
Analyzed balance sheets and income statements, evaluated significant variances.
Conducted substantive analytics and testing on various financial statement lines, ensuring accuracy of balances.
Summarized findings from key client documents like board minutes, internal audit reports, contracts, and legal letters, tracing unusual transaction and enhancing report comprehensiveness.
Performed and reviewed tie-outs (Internal Consistency, Mathematical Accuracy, Prior period checks) for financial statement line items. Engagement Completion and Reporting:
Activly involved in Finalizing audit reports along with onshore team, and other completion workpapers ensuring adherence to disclosure requirements.
Led a team for Stat audit of a PSU and Banks.
Responsible for company audits and tax audits, training staff on auditing methodology and reports.
Financial Accounting & Reporting: Assisted in the meticulous compilation of annual financial statements, managed fixed assets, investment schedules, variance analysis, and bank reconciliations.
Audit: Conducted statutory audits of banks, trusts, and companies, ensuring strict compliance, comprehensive analysis of financial statements and offering valuable recommendations for improvement.
Taxation: Provided support in tax representations, complex filings, Tax Audit report preparation, GST filings, reconciliations, and other tax-related tasks.
